## Publication Information

**Date:** 1862

**Genre:** Fiction (modern)

**Publisher:** 500 printed privately for sale for a charity.

**Notes:** Reprinted as “Lost Heartsease Leaves” in last number of <i>Events of the Month, </i>Jan 2, 1865, pp. 615-618. The letters from Keble reprinted in <i>Musings over the Christian Year</i> make it clear that this was originally written as the ending of <i>Heartsease</i>, and was not an afterthought.
